help.title: Help
help.welcomeDesc: This tool helps verify the integrity of citations in academic essays. It checks if cited references actually exist and match the provided metadata.
help.decisionSupportDesc: This system provides analysis to assist expert review. Final judgment on citation integrity requires human expertise.
help.step3: Each citation is verified against academic databases
help.step4: View results with detailed verdicts and CIS score
help.step5: Export report in JSON, CSV, PDF, or DOCX format
help.gs1Desc: Go to the Upload page and drag & drop your PDF file, or click to select it. The system accepts PDF files up to 50MB.
help.gs2Desc: The analysis typically takes 30-60 seconds depending on the essay length. You can monitor progress in real-time.
help.gs3Desc: View the Citation Integrity Score (CIS) and examine individual citation verdicts. Click on any citation for detailed information.
help.gs4Desc: Download your analysis report in JSON, CSV, PDF, or DOCX format for documentation or further review.
help.cisDesc: The Citation Integrity Score (CIS) is a composite metric (0-100%) indicating the overall integrity of citations in your essay. Higher scores indicate better citation integrity.
